text: invalid_currency is one code for two contradictory rules; expense-list users are told to enter a 3-letter code
relates: T-207 (the currency wording in the same docs pass)

Fixed in 15d9088: new code invalid_list_currency for the list currency (blank on an expenses list, or over 32 chars on any kind), carrying row_id/field; invalid_currency stays for PATCH /settings. Wire contract error table split; both clients map the new code to "Enter a currency for this list, up to 32 characters" in all nine locales; new web apiErrors.test.ts and an ErrorTextTest case; server tests pin both codes. Mutation-checked on server, web and Android.
